units_searched.note: The department Policies & Resources page lists 'Turning in work created by generative AI as one's own' among clearly unacceptable behaviors. This is one line inside a department-wide academic integrity section, with no dedicated AI policy. Course sites (cs356, cs425, cs545) carry a shared 'Academic Integrity' page that says AI tools are allowed with disclosure; that is course-level and was not collected. The old cs.colostate.edu/cstop domain redirects to compsci.colostate.edu.
